```python
def adb_signature(data):
    if len(data) < 24: raise ValueError
    command, arg0, arg1, length, check, magic = struct.unpack('<6I', data[:24])
    if command ^ magic != 0xffffffff: raise
    if length > 65535: raise
    if len(data) != 24 + length: raise ValueError  # exactly length bytes follow, reject trailing
    body = data[24:]
    if checksum(body) != check: raise
    if command == CNXN:
        banner = body.decode('utf-8')  # strict
        version = '%d.%d.%d' % ((arg0>>16)&255,(arg0>>8)&255,arg0&255)
        return ('CNXN', version, banner)
    if command == AUTH:
        return ('AUTH', arg0, arg1, bytes(body))
    raise ValueError('unsupported ADB command')
```

```python
    v1 = read_plist(stream, 'ProductVersion')
    v2 = read_plist(stream, 'ProductName')
    if stream.read(1): raise ValueError('trailing frame')

def read_plist(stream, key):
    header = stream.read(4)
    if len(header) != 4: raise ValueError('short frame')
    size = struct.unpack('>I', header)[0]
    if size < 1 or size > 65532: raise ValueError('bad frame length')
    body = stream.read(size)
    if len(body) != size: raise ValueError('truncated frame')
    value = plistlib.loads(body)   # may raise InvalidFileError/ExpatError/RecursionError/ValueError/TypeError
    if type(value) is not dict: raise
    if set(value) != {'Key','Request','Value'}: raise
    if value['Key'] != key or value['Request'] != 'GetValue': raise
    result = value['Value']
    if type(result) is not str or not result: raise
    return result
```
